# ghost/antimine

Antimine minesweeper (F-Droid): start a new game by difficulty, make the safe opening move, read statistics and settings. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/antimine
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/antimine start_new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/antimine reveal_first_tile --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/antimine get_stats --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/antimine get_settings --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `start_new_game`: Start a new beginner minesweeper game
- `reveal_first_tile`: Start a minesweeper game and make the first move
- `get_stats`: Show my minesweeper statistics
- `get_settings`: Is no-guessing mode on in Antimine?
